sections.en: On the colors of the sun in the zodiac signs

summary.headline: Solar Omens in the Zodiac
summary.text: Omens from the sun’s darkness, redness, halos, and color in the zodiac signs, predicting war, famine, weather, disease, earthquakes, deaths, and regional disasters. The Meccan calculator’s judgments name Syria, Fars, Mosul, Harran, Nisibis, Amol, Medina, Greece, Egypt, and the Maghreb, followed by the moon’s “threshing floor” halo.
